title: enform mail.resent@1 event payload
description: The payload of a mail.resent@1 event (#269, SE-1, I14). A flow owner sent one message of an instance again: the event names the instance, the outbox row the worker re-delivers and the effect it carries. The delivery itself is the worker's record on the row (SE-1); the event is the attributed manual action.

instanceId.description: The id of the instance whose message is sent again (DX-1).

mailId.description: The id of the outbox row, the engine's side-effect key (I3).

effect.description: The effect of the message, such as send-assignment or send-reminder (SE-2).
